newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread says Christmas sales up 8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Whitbread says Christmas sales up 8 pct.

text.p: Brewing-to-leisure group Whitbread Plc said on Monday that its sales in the five-week period from December 1, 1996 grew by eight percent compared to the previous year.
Whibread, however, said its margins were affected by higher costs in its food business and additional promotional support in its take home beer market.
"The trading pattern was a slow pre-holiday period followed by a strong Christmas although bad weather affected new year sales, especially in the south and east," the group said.
There were "particularly strong performances" from Whitbread Inns where food and drinks sales were well ahead.
